title: Food Safety Form
subtitle: Food Safety Control: captures actual activity and handoff.
description: Food Safety Form covers food lot, process step, sanitation control, monitoring point, and corrective action. The food-safety record owner records Food Safety Control activity, quantities, variance, and handoff. Food Safety Form keeps Food Safety Control exceptions visible until the food-safety record owner handoff.
use_case: Use Food Safety Form at receiving, storage, preparation, processing, packing, and service area. Document food lot, process step, sanitation control, monitoring point, and corrective action identity before Food Safety Control begins. Compare food lot, process step, sanitation control, monitoring point, and corrective action findings with stated Food Safety Control criteria; route unresolved Food Safety Control issues to qualified food-safety reviewer. For Food Safety Form, confirm requirements for Food Safety Control. Ask qualified food-safety reviewer to review Food Safety Control conditions beyond the food-safety record owner's role.

blocks.guidance: Stop normal processing when product control, traceability, contamination, corrective action, or qualified disposition remains unresolved. Protect food lot, process step, sanitation control, monitoring point, and corrective action; document the Food Safety Control notification and await qualified food-safety reviewer direction.
